summary: PhotoStructure is a self-hosted media management tool designed to organise collections of photographs and videos into a web-based interface. It can be installed as a native desktop application, run via Node.js, or deployed using Docker.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking to consolidate family media libraries onto their own hardware rather than relying on commercial cloud storage providers.
watchOut: The software is proprietary, and with no recent commits or tagged releases visible, you should consider the long-term maintenance risks of adopting it.
deployNotes: As a Node.js-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your media library and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
